slides.title: Problem Statement
slides.task_brief: Header title 'PROBLEM STATEMENT'. Body = 2x2 grid of .card.accent-top cards, each with a Material icon in an orange-soft rounded square + navy 700 card title + 13.5px body text (3 sentences each, verbatim below). Card 1 — icon 'gpp_maybe', title 'What problem are we addressing?', text: 'Land ownership still runs on fragmented paper registries and siloed digital portals. Title transfers depend on slow manual scrutiny, so records remain easy to forge and hard to verify. There is no single, tamper-proof source of truth for who owns what.' Card 2 — icon 'groups', title 'Who is affected?', text: 'Citizens and buyers risk the same plot being sold to multiple parties. Registrars drown in manual verification workloads, while banks hesitate to lend against titles that cannot be cryptographically proven.' Card 3 — icon 'report_problem', title 'Current challenges', text: 'Forged title deeds and duplicate sales of one property; no immutable ownership history visible to anyone; verification cycles that stretch for weeks; zero public audit trail; records scattered across departments and district offices.' Card 4 — icon 'public', title 'Why is the problem important?', text: 'Land and property disputes drive roughly two-thirds of India civil litigation (Daksh access-to-justice study), locking property capital for decades. Secure, verifiable digital titling is a declared national priority under the DILRMP programme.' Footer left text 'September 2026', footer right text 'Slide 2 of 10'.

slides.title: Existing Solution / Literature Review
slides.layout: split: existing list | limitations list + gap band
slides.task_brief: Header title 'EXISTING SOLUTION / LITERATURE REVIEW'. Body = two columns + full-width bottom band. LEFT column (card, navy-top) titled 'Existing methods & products' with 4 icon-rows (Material icons 'language','account_balance','map','token'): 1) 'State land-record portals — Bhulekh, Mee Bhoomi, Dharani digitized records, but stored in centralized, mutable databases.' 2) 'Sub-Registrar offices — in-person deed registration with paper annexures and wet-ink signatures.' 3) 'DILRMP (Govt. of India) — national programme digitizing records, maps and integration.' 4) 'Blockchain land-title pilots — Georgia, Sweden and Andhra Pradesh proof-of-concepts for registry records.' RIGHT column (card, accent-top) titled 'Limitations of existing solutions' with 4 rows (icon 'close' in soft orange square): 1) 'Centralized databases remain tamper-prone — privileged writes leave no trace.' 2) 'No end-to-end ownership provenance that a buyer can independently verify.' 3) 'Fraud surfaces only after disputes arise; nothing is screened at submission time.' 4) 'Documents verified visually — scans carry no cryptographic proof of authenticity.' BOTTOM band (navy-deep background, white text, accent label 'RESEARCH / MARKET GAP'): 'No existing platform unifies property registry, document integrity, transfer workflow, fraud screening and immutable audit in one always-on system. Land Ledger integrates all five layers and compares favorably on every axis — ownership truth moves on-chain, documents are SHA-256 sealed, and every action is auditable in real time.' Footer 'September 2026' / 'Slide 3 of 10'.

slides.title: Proposed Solution
slides.task_brief: Header title 'PROPOSED SOLUTION'. Body: top full-width statement band (panel-navy card, navy 700 ~17px): 'LAND LEDGER — a role-based web registry where every property, document and ownership transfer is cryptographically verifiable and settled on a blockchain ledger.' Below: 4 horizontal rows (card-white with left orange number chip 01-04, Material icon + navy title + body text, verbatim): Row 01 icon 'lightbulb' title 'Project idea' text 'One integrated platform for citizens and registrars: register properties, upload deed documents, initiate transfers and trace provenance — with fraud screening built into the workflow itself.' Row 02 icon 'account_tree' title 'Proposed approach' text 'React SPA talks to an Express REST API; MongoDB Atlas stores users, properties, documents and transfers, while a Solidity smart contract (LandRegistry.sol) holds on-chain ownership truth. Documents are SHA-256 hashed at upload; every transfer is scored by a 9-check fraud engine before approval.' Row 03 icon 'auto_awesome' title 'Key innovation' text 'The smart contract itself rejects provenance mismatches — ownership can only move along the chain of legitimate owners. Fraud is screened at submission, not after the dispute, and every API action appends to an immutable audit stream streamed live to the dashboard.' Row 04 icon 'flag' title 'Expected outcome' text 'A single trusted source of property truth, buyer-verifiable provenance, fraud blocked before settlement, and 24/7 availability from MongoDB Atlas cloud — no local database to keep running.' Footer 'September 2026' / 'Slide 4 of 10'.

slides.title: Objectives
slides.layout: numbered objective list + measurable targets strip
slides.task_brief: Header title 'OBJECTIVES'. Body: 5 numbered rows (large navy 800 number in orange-soft square, 14px text) then a measurable-targets strip at bottom. Objectives verbatim: 1) 'Digitize the land registry behind secure, role-based access — separate registrar and citizen portals with JWT + bcrypt authentication.' 2) 'Anchor every ownership change on an immutable EVM ledger through the LandRegistry.sol smart contract with on-chain provenance enforcement.' 3) 'Guarantee document integrity using SHA-256 hashing at upload with independent re-verification on demand.' 4) 'Automate transfer risk screening with a deterministic 9-check fraud engine (PASS / WARN / FAIL) before registrar approval.' 5) 'Ship a production-grade platform with CI/CD pipelines, Prometheus + Grafana observability and 24/7 MongoDB Atlas cloud storage.' Targets strip (navy-deep band, white text, 5 stat cells with orange 700 numbers): '100% transfers settled on-chain' / '0 unverified documents accepted' / '1 audit event per API action' / '29/29 API · 20/20 contract tests' / '0 local DB dependency (Atlas M0)'. Footer 'September 2026' / 'Slide 5 of 10'.

slides.title: System Architecture / Methodology
slides.task_brief: Header title 'SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE / METHODOLOGY'. Body top ~72%: layered block diagram built from CSS boxes only (no SVG). Four stacked layers, each a row label chip on the left (navy-deep chip, white text, rotated-none, ~110px wide: 'CLIENTS','API LAYER','CORE SERVICES','DATA & LEDGER') and boxes to the right with '→' arrow glyphs between layers. Layer 1 (two boxes): 'Citizen Portal' + 'Registrar Console' with sub-line 'React 18 · Vite · Tailwind CSS (responsive 360–1280 px)'. Layer 2 (one wide box): 'Express REST API — Helmet · JWT + bcrypt auth · RBAC · rate limiting · /health · /metrics'. Layer 3 (four boxes): 'Fraud engine — 9 deterministic checks', 'Document service — SHA-256 + Multer', 'Transfer orchestrator', 'Audit service'. Layer 4 (three boxes): 'MongoDB Atlas — 8 collections · 24/7 cloud (orange left-border highlight)', 'LandRegistry.sol — local EVM via Hardhat · ethers v6', 'Uploads volume — original PDFs'. Bottom ~28%: horizontal 7-step workflow pipeline of small chips connected by '→' glyphs (orange step numbers): 'Register property' → 'Upload & hash documents' → 'Initiate transfer' → 'Fraud screening' → 'Registrar approval' → 'On-chain settlement' → 'Audit event logged'. Footer 'September 2026' / 'Slide 6 of 10'.

slides.title: Innovation, Impact, Deliverables & Future Scope
slides.task_brief: Header title 'INNOVATION, IMPACT, DELIVERABLES & FUTURE SCOPE'. Body = 2x2 bento of cards, each with icon + navy 700 title + 4 compact rows (11.5-12.5px). Q1 icon 'science' title 'Innovation' rows: 'On-chain provenance enforcement — contract rejects ownership-chain mismatches' / 'Fraud screened at submission time via 9 deterministic checks' / 'SHA-256 tamper evidence for every deed document' / 'Live immutable audit stream from Atlas on the registrar dashboard'. Q2 icon 'insights' title 'Impact' rows: 'Buyers independently verify ownership before paying' / 'Registrars decide faster with risk scores pre-computed' / 'Courts receive immutable, timestamped evidence' / 'Registry reachable 24/7 from anywhere — zero local infrastructure'. Q3 icon 'inventory' title 'Deliverables' rows: 'Full-stack web platform — 45+ frontend files, 10 API modules' / 'Audited LandRegistry.sol contract with 20-test suite' / 'REST API verified by 29 automated tests + E2E browser sweep' / 'Docker / Kubernetes / Jenkins CI-CD + Grafana observability'. Q4 icon 'rocket_launch' title 'Future scope' rows: 'Hosted testnet deployment (Polygon Amoy) for public access' / 'Aadhaar-based e-KYC for identity assurance' / 'GIS map layers and OCR auto-extraction of deed data' / 'SMS / WhatsApp alerts and AI-assisted valuation hints'. Footer 'September 2026' / 'Slide 9 of 10'.
